items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He knows Arnold Leuco knows that the Rocker didn't. [INTERVIEWEE] He couldn't play a funeral. He didn't know. He knows it.

ctx.x: And I'll give it to him. He give it to him in no... No. That was Arnold Leuco. Arnold Leuco, yeah.
Poor Nick LaRocca never played no funeral. He couldn't play a funeral.
